question: What are Nagwa’s official working days and days off?
expected_answer: Working days are Sunday to Thursday. Friday and Saturday are days off.

question: What are the core working hours in the flexi-time system?
expected_answer: Core working hours are from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm.

question: What is the earliest time an employee can start work?
expected_answer: The earliest time an employee can start work is 8:00 am.

question: What happens if an employee fails to complete the daily working hours?
expected_answer: The deficit is deducted from the employee’s gross salary at double the rate.

question: Can departments suspend the flexi-time system?
expected_answer: Yes. Departments or teams, with HR collaboration, may suspend flexi-time for up to two weeks to meet operational requirements, with one week’s notice.

question: What should an employee do if they forget or lose their company ID card?
expected_answer: They must report their daily attendance by email to HR while carbon copying their direct manager, and manually sign in/out using attendance sheets at the security desk.

question: What happens if an employee signs in or out for another employee?
expected_answer: It is strictly prohibited and both employees may be subject to disciplinary action, including termination.

question: What is the penalty for unauthorized absence?
expected_answer: Unauthorized absences are deducted from the employee’s salary at double the rate.

question: When can unjustified absence lead to termination?
expected_answer: Unjustified absence for more than 20 scattered days a year or 10 consecutive days may subject the employee to termination.

question: How is overtime paid?
expected_answer: Overtime is paid at one and a half times the gross rate from Sunday to Thursday and at double the gross rate during days off.

question: Are part-timers entitled to annual or sick leave?
expected_answer: No. Part-timers are not entitled to sick, annual, or any other type of leave.

question: How can a part-time contract be terminated?
expected_answer: The part-timer may terminate the contract with written notice of two weeks. Nagwa may terminate the contract without indemnity at any moment upon verbal or written notice.

question: How many annual leave days do employees get?
expected_answer: Employees get 15 days in the first year, 21 days starting from the second year, and 30 days if they have 10 years or more of social insurance or are over 50 years old.

question: Are Fridays and Saturdays counted as annual leave?
expected_answer: No. Fridays and Saturdays are days off, and holidays are not counted as annual leaves.

question: When can an employee start using their leave balance?
expected_answer: Starting from the first day of the second quarter of being hired.

question: What happens to unused vacation balance exceeding 10 days?
expected_answer: Unused vacation balance exceeding 10 days will not be forwarded to the following year.

question: What happens if an employee consumes their annual leave balance and then takes more leave?
expected_answer: Any additional leave will be deducted from the employee’s salary at double the rate.

question: How many paid sick leave days are employees eligible for?
expected_answer: Employees are eligible for up to 5 working days of paid sick leave per calendar year at 75% of the gross salary, with appropriate medical documentation.

question: How many days are granted for bereavement leave?
expected_answer: A maximum of 3 calendar days is granted in case of the death of a first-degree relative.

question: What is the educational leave entitlement for core business training?
expected_answer: The employee is entitled to 15 paid days and 15 unpaid days.
